name: imhist
comment: Sig [counts,x]=imhist(I,n). counts unchanged; x (bin locations) spans the input CLASS display range: double/single/logical -> [0,1]; uint8 -> [0,255]; uint16 -> [0,65535]; int16 -> [-32768,32767]. imhist(uint8([0 64 128 192 255]),4) -> counts [1 1 2 1], x [0 85 170 255]. double n=4 x = [0 .3333 .6667 1]. uint16 n=3 x = [0 32767.5 65535]. numkit previously returned [0,1] x for ALL classes -- fixed. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
